AI Settings
Vision Model Filters
Send the live frame to Doubao vision model to design each filter for the actual scene. Offline or errors fall back to on-device generation automatically.
Volcengine Ark API
Two things to get right:
1. Key: create/copy it at the Ark API Key page — paste the full secret string. The label shown in the console (e.g. api-key-2026…) is the key's NAME and will not work.
2. Model: activate a vision/chat model such as Doubao-Seed-1.6 in Model Management, then tap a chip above. Video models like Seedance cannot read images. The key stays only on this device.
How it works
Every swipe switches filters instantly — there is zero waiting. After you swipe, a small thumbnail of the viewfinder is sent to the model in the background; its scene-tuned filter is queued up and appears on a following swipe (marked with the purple dot). If the network is slow or offline, on-device generation simply keeps the feed flowing.
